pages.quiz:
HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #12 (TERM 3)
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 60 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What does atma mean? (1 mark)
   A. Fire
   B. Body
   C. Water
   D. Soul

2. Which principle is about kindness to all living beings? (1 mark)
   A. Purushartha
   B. Paramatma
   C. Prani Daya
   D. Punarjanam

3. Which is an act of Prani Daya? (1 mark)
   A. Breaking plants
   B. Throwing stones at a dog
   C. Giving water to a thirsty animal
   D. Wasting food

4. Which of these is a good way to pray? (1 mark)
   A. Ask only for gifts
   B. Sit and laugh
   C. Shout
   D. Say thank you and ask for wisdom and kindness

5. What does Prani mean? (1 mark)
   A. A river
   B. A living being
   C. A stone
   D. A plant only

6. What does Daya mean? (1 mark)
   A. Kindness or compassion
   B. Speed
   C. Wealth
   D. Anger

7. In which months does Paryushan usually occur? (1 mark)
   A. February or March
   B. December
   C. June
   D. August or September

8. What is the first line of the Kenyan National Anthem? (1 mark)
   A. Om Bhur Bhuvah Svah
   B. Ya Kundendu Tushara
   C. Twameva mata cha pita twameva
   D. Ee Mungu nguvu yetu

9. Which mistake is common about Madaraka Day? (1 mark)
   A. Knowing it is 1 June
   B. Knowing it is for patriots
   C. Knowing the flag is raised
   D. Thinking it is Independence Day

10. How can we help a friend who uses a wheelchair at a festival? (1 mark)
   A. Help them to move safely and include them
   B. Laugh
   C. Leave them alone
   D. Ignore them

11. What do Jains say on the last day of Paryushan? (1 mark)
   A. Micchami Dukkadam
   B. Om Namah Shivaya
   C. Namaste
   D. Sat Sri Akal

12. Which leaves are offered to Shiva on Maha Shivratri? (1 mark)
   A. Tea leaves
   B. Banana leaves
   C. Bel (bilva) leaves
   D. Tulsi leaves only

13. Which festival is a national festival? (1 mark)
   A. Madaraka Day
   B. Paryushan Parva
   C. Maha Shivratri
   D. Vasant Panchami

14. How many days are in the week in the Indian traditional calendar? (1 mark)
   A. Six
   B. Seven
   C. Eight
   D. Five

15. What is the Indian name for Thursday? (1 mark)
   A. Shukravaar
   B. Guruvaar
   C. Shanivaar
   D. Ravivaar

16. Which of these is a month of the Indian traditional calendar? (1 mark)
   A. June
   B. January
   C. Chaitra
   D. March

17. Budh is the Indian name for which planet? (1 mark)
   A. Saturn
   B. Jupiter
   C. Mercury
   D. Mars

18. What is the Indian name for Friday? (1 mark)
   A. Somvaar
   B. Guruvaar
   C. Budhvaar
   D. Shukravaar

19. What is the Indian name for Tuesday? (1 mark)
   A. Mangalvaar
   B. Ravivaar
   C. Shukravaar
   D. Somvaar

20. Which planet is called the red planet? (1 mark)
   A. Venus
   B. Jupiter
   C. Mars
   D. Saturn

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
21. Explain how a school can make festivals inclusive. (4 marks)

22. Describe how Maha Shivratri is celebrated. (3 marks)

23. What does Prani Daya mean? (2 marks)

24. Give three safety measures to observe during festivals. (3 marks)

25. Why should we respect others who have different beliefs about death? (3 marks)

26. Compare the three festivals: Maha Shivratri, Paryushan Parva and Madaraka Day. (5 marks)

27. Explain why the Indian traditional calendar is special and how a child can use it. (5 marks)

28. Which festival in the lesson is a national holiday and why? (2 marks)

29. Name the months of the Indian traditional calendar in which Maha Shivratri and Paryushan fall. (3 marks)
pages.answers:
HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #12 (TERM 3) · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. D — Soul
   Atma is the soul.

2. C — Prani Daya
   Prani Daya is compassion.

3. C — Giving water to a thirsty animal
   Kindness to living beings.

4. D — Say thank you and ask for wisdom and kindness
   Ask for wisdom, not only gifts.

5. B — A living being
   Prani is a living creature.

6. A — Kindness or compassion
   Daya is compassion.

7. D — August or September
   It falls in Bhadrapada.

8. D — Ee Mungu nguvu yetu
   The anthem is Ee Mungu Nguvu Yetu.

9. D — Thinking it is Independence Day
   Independence is 12 December.

10. A — Help them to move safely and include them
   Inclusion is important.

11. A — Micchami Dukkadam
   It asks for forgiveness.

12. C — Bel (bilva) leaves
   Bel leaves are offered.

13. A — Madaraka Day
   It is celebrated by all Kenyans.

14. B — Seven
   Seven days.

15. B — Guruvaar
   Guru is Jupiter.

16. C — Chaitra
   Chaitra is the first month.

17. C — Mercury
   Budh is Mercury.

18. D — Shukravaar
   Shukra is Venus.

19. A — Mangalvaar
   Mangal is Mars.

20. C — Mars
   Mars is the red planet.

SECTION B
----
21. (4 marks)
   Answer: Give clear instructions, help learners with special needs to take part, share food and clothes with the needy, and invite all faiths and communities.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

22. (3 marks)
   Answer: People fast, keep an all-night vigil, bathe the Shiva Linga with water and milk, offer bel leaves, chant Om Namah Shivaya and visit the Mandir.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct practice.

23. (2 marks)
   Answer: Kindness to all living beings.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each for kindness and living beings.

24. (3 marks)
   Answer: Adults light lamps, stay with adults in crowds, wash hands before eating, use bins, walk and do not run (any three).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

25. (3 marks)
   Answer: People hold different views, listening with respect keeps peace, and arguing does not help.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

26. (5 marks)
   Answer: Maha Shivratri is Hindu, a night of prayer for Shiva. Paryushan is Jain, of fasting and forgiveness. Madaraka Day is national, about self-government and patriotism. All bring people together.
   Working / marking points: 2 marks for correct faith or type, 2 marks for themes, 1 mark for a similarity.

27. (5 marks)
   Answer: It links daily life to the sky and seasons, keeps tradition alive and fixes festival dates. A child can make a weekly plan, a decorated calendar, greeting cards or a song.
   Working / marking points: 2 marks for why it is special and 3 marks for uses.

28. (2 marks)
   Answer: Madaraka Day, because it marks a step in Kenya's history and all Kenyans celebrate it.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

29. (3 marks)
   Answer: Maha Shivratri in Phalguna and Paryushan in Bhadrapada.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each and 1 mark for correct spelling.
